units.zh: 慕容德
units.en: Murong De.
units.literal: Murong De.

units.zh: 慕容德，字玄明，皝之少子也，母公孫氏夢日入臍中，晝寢而生德。
units.en: Murong De, whose courtesy name was Xuanming, was Murong Huang’s youngest son. His mother Lady Gongsun dreamed of the sun slipping into her navel, then bore him in a daytime doze.
units.literal: Murong De, courtesy name Xuanming, was the youngest son of Huang; his mother Lady Gongsun dreamed the sun entered her navel and, sleeping by day, gave birth to De.

units.zh: 年未弱冠，身長八尺二寸，姿貌雄偉，額有日角偃月重文。
units.en: Before he came of age he already stood eight feet two inches tall, cut an imposing figure, and bore the paired “sun-brow” and “crescent moon” lines on his forehead that physiognomists read as imperial signs.
units.literal: Before the weak-crown age he was eight chi two cun in height, his bearing majestic, his forehead having double markings of sun-corner and reclining moon.

units.zh: 博觀群書，性清慎，多才藝。
units.en: He read widely, kept a cool and careful temper, and excelled at more than one craft.
units.literal: He broadly perused many books; his nature was clear and cautious; he had many talents and arts.

units.zh: 慕容俊之僭立也，封為梁公，曆幽州刺史、左衛將軍。
units.en: When Murong Jun declared himself emperor, Murong De was made duke of Liang and rose through posts as inspector of You and general of the left guard.
units.literal: When Murong Jun presumptuously established himself, he was enfeoffed Duke of Liang, and served as inspector of You Province and left guard general.

units.zh: 及垂嗣位，改范陽王，稍遷魏尹，加散騎常侍。
units.en: When Murong Chui took the throne Murong De was refashioned prince of Fanyang, then advanced to prefect of the Wei capital region and given the concurrent title of regular attendant for scattered cavalry.
units.literal: When Chui succeeded the throne, [De] was changed to Prince of Fanyang, gradually promoted to Yin of Wei (capital-region prefect), and given the additional title of Cavalier Regular Attendant.

units.zh: 俄而苻堅將苻雙據陝以叛，堅將苻柳起兵枹罕，將應之。
units.en: Soon Fu Shuang, one of Fu Jian’s generals, rebelled from Shan commandery, while another general, Fu Liu, rose at Baohan to join him.
units.literal: Soon Fu Jian’s general Fu Shuang seized Shan and rebelled; Jian’s general Fu Liu raised troops at Baohan to respond to him.

units.zh: 德勸垂乘釁討堅，辭旨慷慨，識者言其有遠略，垂竟不能用。
units.en: Murong De urged Murong Chui to strike Fu Jian while Qin was divided, speaking with such fire that men of judgment called him far-sighted—yet Murong Chui would not act.
units.literal: De urged Chui to exploit the opening to punish Jian; his words were fervent; observers said he had long-range strategy; Chui in the end could not employ it.

units.zh: 德兄垂甚壯之，因共論軍國大謀，言必切至。
units.en: Murong Chui, impressed, began debating statecraft and strategy with him, and Murong De’s advice was always blunt and to the point.
units.literal: De’s elder brother Chui greatly admired him; therefore they together discussed great plans of army and state; his words were always incisive and to the point.

units.zh: 垂謂之曰：「汝器識長進，非復吳下阿蒙也。」
units.en: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer the young Meng east of Wu.”
units.literal: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer the young Meng east of Wu.”

units.zh: 枋頭之役，德以征南將軍與垂擊敗晉師。
units.en: At the battle of Fangtou he joined Murong Chui as general who campaigns south and helped shatter the Eastern Jin army.
units.literal: In the Fangtou campaign, De as general who campaigns south together with Chui struck and defeated Jin troops.

units.zh: 及垂奔苻堅，德坐免職。
units.en: When Murong Chui defected to Fu Jian, Murong De lost his post as an accomplice.
units.literal: When Chui fled to Fu Jian, De sat fault and was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 後遇垂敗，徙于長安，苻堅以為張掖太守，數歲免歸。
units.en: After Murong Chui’s defeat he was moved to Chang’an, where Fu Jian named him prefect of Zhangye; a few years later he was dismissed and sent home.
units.literal: Later encountering Chui’s defeat, he was moved to Chang’an; Fu Jian appointed him prefect of Zhangye; after several years he was dismissed and returned.

units.zh: 及堅以兵臨江，拜德為奮威將軍。
units.en: When Fu Jian marched his host to the great river, he named Murong De general who rouses might.
units.literal: When Jian led troops to the Yangzi, he appointed De general who rouses might.

units.zh: 堅之敗也，堅與張夫人相失，慕容垂將護致之，德正色謂垂曰：「昔楚莊滅陳，納巫臣之諫而棄夏姬。
units.en: When Jian was defeated, he and Consort Zhang lost each other. Murong Chui was about to escort her back, but De, with a stern expression, said to Chui: “When King Zhuang of Chu destroyed Chen, he accepted Wu Chen’s remonstrance and cast aside Xia Ji.
units.literal: When Jian was defeated, he and Consort Zhang lost each other. Murong Chui was about to escort her back, but De, with a stern expression, said to Chui: “When King Zhuang of Chu destroyed Chen, he accepted Wu Chen’s remonstrance and cast aside Xia Ji.

units.zh: 此不祥之人，惑亂人主，戎事不邇女器，秦之敗師當由於此。
units.en: This is an inauspicious woman who deludes and disorders rulers. In military affairs one does not bring women near; Qin’s defeat in battle must have come from this.
units.literal: This is an inauspicious woman who deludes and disorders rulers. In military affairs one does not bring women near; Qin’s defeat in battle must have come from this.

units.zh: 宜掩目而過，奈何將衛之也！」
units.en: You should cover your eyes and pass her by—how can you intend to escort and protect her!”
units.literal: You should cover your eyes and pass her by—how can you intend to escort and protect her!”

units.zh: 垂不從，德馳馬而去之。
units.en: Murong Chui refused to listen; Murong De spurred his horse and rode away in disgust.
units.literal: Chui did not follow; De galloped horse and left him.

units.zh: 還次滎陽，言於垂曰：「昔句踐棲於會稽，終獲吳國。
units.en: When he returned and halted at Xingyang, he said to Chui: “In the past Goujian lodged at Kuaiji, yet in the end he gained the state of Wu.
units.literal: When he returned and halted at Xingyang, he said to Chui: “In the past Goujian lodged at Kuaiji, yet in the end he gained the state of Wu.

units.zh: 聖人相時而動，百舉百全。
units.en: Sages observe the times and move; in a hundred undertakings, a hundred are completed.
units.literal: Sages observe the times and move; in a hundred undertakings, a hundred are completed.

units.zh: 天將悔禍，故使秦師喪敗，宜乘其弊以復社稷。」
units.en: Heaven is about to repent of the calamity, and so it has caused Qin’s army to be lost and defeated. We should ride their exhaustion to restore the altars of state.”
units.literal: Heaven is about to repent of the calamity, and so it has caused Qin’s army to be lost and defeated. We should ride their exhaustion to restore the altars of state.”

units.zh: 垂不納。
units.en: Murong Chui would not listen.
units.literal: Chui did not accept.

units.zh: 乃從垂如鄴。
units.en: Murong De followed him north to Ye.
units.literal: Thereupon he followed Chui to Ye.

units.zh: 及垂稱燕王，以德為車騎大將軍，復封范陽王，居中鎮衛，參斷政事。
units.en: When Murong Chui declared himself king of Yan he made Murong De grand general of chariots and cavalry, restored his princedom of Fanyang, kept him at court to secure the capital, and gave him a voice in every policy decision.
units.literal: When Chui styled himself King of Yan, he appointed De chariot-and-cavalry grand general, again enfeoffed Prince of Fanyang, stayed within to guard and defend, and joined in deciding government affairs.

units.zh: 久之，遷司徙。
units.en: In time he was promoted to minister of education.
units.literal: In time he was promoted to minister of education.

units.zh: 于時慕容永據長子，有眾十萬，垂議討之。
units.en: At that time Murong Yong held Changzi with a hundred thousand men under arms, and Murong Chui planned a campaign against him.
units.literal: At that time Murong Yong held Changzi and had a host of one hundred thousand, and Murong Chui deliberated attacking him.

units.zh: 群臣咸以為疑，德進曰：「昔三祖積德，遺詠在耳，故陛下龍飛，不謀而會，雖由聖武，亦緣舊愛，燕、趙之士樂為燕臣也。
units.en: The ministers all harbored doubts, and Murong De stepped forward and said: “Formerly the three ancestors accumulated virtue, and their lingering songs are still in our ears. Therefore when Your Majesty rose like a dragon, men gathered without prior plotting; though this was due to your sacred martial power, it also came from old affection, and the men of Yan and Zhao were glad to be subjects of Yan.
units.literal: The ministers all harbored doubts, and Murong De stepped forward and said: “Formerly the three ancestors accumulated virtue, and their lingering songs are still in our ears. Therefore when Your Majesty rose like a dragon, men gathered without prior plotting; though this was due to your sacred martial power, it also came from old affection, and the men of Yan and Zhao were glad to be subjects of Yan.

units.zh: 今永既建偽號，扇動華戎，致令群豎從橫，逐鹿不息，宜先除之，以一眾聽。
units.en: Now Yong has already assumed a false title, stirred up Chinese and non-Chinese, and caused petty rivals to range unchecked while the struggle for the realm does not cease. He should be removed first, in order to unify what the multitude hears.
units.literal: Now Yong has already assumed a false title, stirred up Chinese and non-Chinese, and caused petty rivals to range unchecked while the struggle for the realm does not cease. He should be removed first, in order to unify what the multitude hears.

units.zh: 昔光武馳蘇茂之難，不顧百官之疲，夫豈不仁？
units.en: Formerly Guangwu hurried through the crisis of Su Mao and did not heed the weariness of the hundred officials; was this because he was not humane?
units.literal: Formerly Guangwu hurried through the crisis of Su Mao and did not heed the weariness of the hundred officials; was this because he was not humane?

units.zh: 機急故也。
units.en: The opportunity was urgent; that was the reason.
units.literal: The opportunity was urgent; that was the reason.

units.zh: 兵法有不得已而用之，陛下容得已乎！」
units.en: The art of war permits using force when one cannot do otherwise. Can Your Majesty do otherwise?”
units.literal: The art of war permits using force when one cannot do otherwise. Can Your Majesty do otherwise?”

units.zh: 垂笑謂其黨曰：「司徒議與吾同。
units.en: Murong Chui smiled and told his followers: “The Minister of Education’s view matches my own.
units.literal: Murong Chui smiled and told his followers: “The Minister of Education’s view matches my own.

units.zh: 二人同心，其利斷金，吾計決矣。」
units.en: When two share one mind, their edge can cut metal; my plan is settled.”
units.literal: When two share one mind, their edge can cut metal; my plan is settled.”

units.zh: 遂從之。
units.en: Murong Chui accepted the advice.
units.literal: Thereupon Murong Chui followed it.

units.zh: 垂臨終，敕其子寶以鄴城委德。
units.en: On his deathbed Murong Chui ordered Murong Bao to place Ye in Murong De's hands.
units.literal: As Murong Chui neared death, he instructed his son Murong Bao to entrust Ye to Murong De.

units.zh: 寶既嗣位，以德為使持節、都督冀、兗、青、徐、荊、豫六州諸軍事、特進、車騎大將軍、冀州牧，領南蠻校尉，鎮鄴，罷留台，以都督專總南夏。
units.en: Once Murong Bao had taken the throne, he named Murong De commissioner with credentials, supreme commander over military affairs in Ji, Yan, Qing, Xu, Jing, and Yu, specially advanced, chariot-and-cavalry general-in-chief, and governor of Ji, with the southern barbarian colonelcy, based at Ye; he dissolved the rear administration and concentrated southern affairs under Murong De's unified command.
units.literal: After Murong Bao succeeded, he appointed Murong De as commissioner bearing credentials, area commander-in-chief of military affairs in the six provinces Ji, Yan, Qing, Xu, Jing, and Yu, specially advanced, chariot-and-cavalry general-in-chief, governor of Ji, concurrently colonel of the Southern Man, stationed at Ye; he abolished the rear headquarters and used the area command to oversee the southern Xia domains in full.

units.zh: 魏將拓拔章攻鄴，德遣南安王慕容青等夜擊，敗之。
units.en: The Wei commander Tuoba Zhang assaulted Ye, and Murong De dispatched Murong Qing, Prince of Nan'an, and others on a night attack that routed him.
units.literal: Wei general Tuoba Zhang attacked Ye, and Murong De sent Murong Qing, Prince of Nan'an, and others to strike by night and defeated him.

units.zh: 魏師退次新城，青等請擊之。
units.en: The Wei forces pulled back to Xincheng, where Murong Qing and his colleagues asked permission to attack.
units.literal: The Wei army withdrew and halted at Xincheng, and Murong Qing and others requested to strike them.

units.zh: 別駕韓𧨳進曰：「古人先決勝廟堂，然後攻戰。
units.en: Adjutant Han Fan stepped forward and said: “The ancients first decided victory in the council hall and only afterward fought.
units.literal: Adjutant Han Fan stepped forward and said: “The ancients first decided victory in the council hall and only afterward fought.

units.zh: 今魏不可擊者四，燕不宜動者三。
units.en: Now there are four reasons Wei cannot be attacked and three reasons Yan ought not move.
units.literal: Now there are four reasons Wei cannot be attacked and three reasons Yan ought not move.

units.zh: 魏懸軍遠入，利在野戰，一不可擊也。
units.en: Wei has hung an army far from home and profits from field battle: this is the first reason it cannot be attacked.
units.literal: Wei has hung an army far from home and profits from field battle: this is the first reason it cannot be attacked.

units.zh: 深入近畿，頓兵死地，二不可擊也。
units.en: They have penetrated near the capital region and halted their troops on deadly ground: this is the second reason they cannot be attacked.
units.literal: They have penetrated near the capital region and halted their troops on deadly ground: this is the second reason they cannot be attacked.

units.zh: 前鋒既敗，後陣方固，三不可擊也。
units.en: Their vanguard has already been defeated, while the rear formation is just becoming firm: this is the third reason they cannot be attacked.
units.literal: Their vanguard has already been defeated, while the rear formation is just becoming firm: this is the third reason they cannot be attacked.

units.zh: 彼眾我寡，四不可擊也。
units.en: They are many and we are few: this is the fourth reason they cannot be attacked.
units.literal: They are many and we are few: this is the fourth reason they cannot be attacked.

units.zh: 官軍自戰其地，一不宜動。
units.en: Our army is fighting on its own ground: this is the first reason we ought not move.
units.literal: Our army is fighting on its own ground: this is the first reason we ought not move.

units.zh: 動而不勝，眾心難固，二不宜動。
units.en: If we move and do not win, the hearts of the host will be hard to steady: this is the second reason we ought not move.
units.literal: If we move and do not win, the hearts of the host will be hard to steady: this is the second reason we ought not move.

units.zh: 城郭未修，敵來無備，三不宜動。
units.en: The city walls and moats have not yet been repaired; if the enemy comes, we will be unprepared: this is the third reason we ought not move.
units.literal: The city walls and moats have not yet been repaired; if the enemy comes, we will be unprepared: this is the third reason we ought not move.

units.zh: 此皆兵家所忌，不如深溝高壘，以逸待勞。
units.en: These are all things military strategists dread. Better to dig deep moats and raise high ramparts, awaiting their exhaustion from a position of ease.
units.literal: These are all things military strategists dread. Better to dig deep moats and raise high ramparts, awaiting their exhaustion from a position of ease.

units.zh: 彼千里饋糧，野無所掠，久則三軍靡資，攻則眾旅多斃，師老釁生，詳而圖之，可以捷矣。」
units.en: They will haul grain a thousand li while the wilderness offers nothing to plunder. In time their three armies will lack supplies; if they attack, many companies will perish; when the army ages, openings will arise. Study this carefully, and we can win.”
units.literal: They will haul grain a thousand li while the wilderness offers nothing to plunder. In time their three armies will lack supplies; if they attack, many companies will perish; when the army ages, openings will arise. Study this carefully, and we can win.”

units.zh: 德曰：「韓別駕之言，良、平之策也。」
units.en: Murong De said: “Adjutant Han Fan’s words are a strategy worthy of Zhang Liang and Chen Ping.”
units.literal: Murong De said: “Adjutant Han Fan’s words are a strategy worthy of Zhang Liang and Chen Ping.”

units.zh: 於是召青還師。
units.en: He therefore recalled Murong Qing and withdrew the troops.
units.literal: Thereupon he summoned Murong Qing to return the army.

units.zh: 魏又遣遼西公賀賴盧率騎與章圍鄴，德遣其參軍劉藻請救于姚興，且參母兄之問，而興師不至，眾大懼。
units.en: Wei dispatched Helai Lu, Prince of Liaoxi, with cavalry to cooperate with Tuoba Zhang in the siege of Ye; Murong De sent Liu Zao to Yao Xing for aid and news of his mother and brother, but no relief came and panic spread through the ranks.
units.literal: Wei again sent Prince of Liaoxi Helai Lu leading cavalry to join Tuoba Zhang in besieging Ye, and Murong De sent his staff adviser Liu Zao to beg rescue from Yao Xing and also to inquire after Murong De's mother and elder brother, but Yao Xing's army did not arrive and the host was greatly afraid.

units.zh: 德於是親饗戰士，厚加撫接，人感其恩，皆樂為致死。
units.en: Murong De then hosted the soldiers himself, lavished care on them, and they repaid his kindness with a will to fight to the death.
units.literal: Murong De then personally feasted the fighters, treated them generously and comforted them, and men were moved by his kindness and all were glad to die for him.

units.zh: 會章、盧內相乖爭，各引軍潛遁。
units.en: Tuoba Zhang and Helai Lu fell into mutual discord and slipped away with their commands.
units.literal: It happened that Tuoba Zhang and Helai Lu quarreled within their ranks and each secretly led his army away.

units.zh: 章司馬丁建率眾來降，言章師老，可以敗之。
units.en: Ding Jian, chief clerk under Tuoba Zhang, defected with his troops and reported that Zhang's army was exhausted and vulnerable.
units.literal: Tuoba Zhang's chief clerk Ding Jian led his masses to surrender and said Tuoba Zhang's army was worn and could be defeated.

units.zh: 德遣將追破章軍，人心始固。
units.en: Murong De sent a commander in pursuit who crushed Tuoba Zhang's force, and morale finally firmed.
units.literal: Murong De sent a general in pursuit and broke Tuoba Zhang's army, and only then did hearts begin to steady.

units.zh: 時魏師入中山，慕容寶出奔于薊，慕容詳又僭號。
units.en: Meanwhile Wei troops entered Zhongshan, Murong Bao fled toward Ji, and Murong Xiang proclaimed himself at Zhongshan.
units.literal: At that time Wei's army entered Zhongshan, Murong Bao fled toward Ji, and Murong Xiang again assumed an illegitimate title.

units.zh: 會劉藻自姚興而至，興太史令高魯遣其甥王景暉隨藻送玉璽一紐，並圖識秘文，曰：「有德者昌，無德者亡。
units.en: It happened that Liu Zao returned from Yao Xing. Yao Xing’s grand astrologer Gao Lu sent his nephew Wang Jinghui with Liu Zao to deliver a jade seal, along with charts and esoteric prophetic texts, saying: “Those with virtue flourish; those without virtue perish.
units.literal: It happened that Liu Zao returned from Yao Xing. Yao Xing’s grand astrologer Gao Lu sent his nephew Wang Jinghui with Liu Zao to deliver a jade seal, along with charts and esoteric prophetic texts, saying: “Those with virtue flourish; those without virtue perish.

units.zh: 德受天命，柔而復剛。」
units.en: De receives Heaven’s mandate, soft and then hard.”
units.literal: De receives Heaven’s mandate, soft and then hard.”

units.zh: 又有謠曰：「大風蓬勃揚塵埃，八井三刀卒起來，四海鼎沸中山頹，惟有德人據三台。」
units.en: There was also a rhyme: “A great wind suddenly raises dust; eight wells and three blades suddenly rise; the four seas seethe like a cauldron and Zhongshan falls; only the man of virtue occupies the Three Terraces.”
units.literal: There was also a rhyme: “A great wind suddenly raises dust; eight wells and three blades suddenly rise; the four seas seethe like a cauldron and Zhongshan falls; only the man of virtue occupies the Three Terraces.”

units.zh: 於是德之群臣議以慕容詳僭號中山，魏師盛于冀州，未審寶之存亡，因勸德即尊號。
units.en: Murong De's officials argued that with Murong Xiang's usurpation at Zhongshan, Wei's power swelling in Ji, and Murong Bao's fate uncertain, Murong De should take the imperial dignity.
units.literal: Thereupon Murong De's ministers deliberated because Murong Xiang had usurped the title at Zhongshan, Wei's army was strong in Ji province, and Murong Bao's life or death was unknown, and they therefore urged Murong De to assume the supreme honor.

units.zh: 德不從。
units.en: Murong De refused.
units.literal: Murong De did not comply.

units.zh: 會慕容達自龍城奔鄴，稱寶猶存，群議乃止。
units.en: Soon Murong Da arrived from Longcheng claiming Murong Bao was alive, and the push for enthronement stopped.
units.literal: It happened that Murong Da fled from Longcheng to Ye and declared that Murong Bao still lived, and the collective deliberation then ceased.

units.zh: 尋而寶以德為丞相，領冀州牧，承制南夏。
units.en: Murong Bao then appointed Murong De chancellor and governor of Ji, empowering him to govern the south.
units.literal: Before long Murong Bao made Murong De chancellor and governor of Ji, with delegated authority over the southern Xia domains.

units.zh: 德兄子麟自義台奔鄴，因說德曰：「中山既沒，魏必乘勝攻鄴，雖糧儲素積，而城大難固，且人情沮動，不可以戰。
units.en: Murong De’s nephew Murong Lin fled from Yitai to Ye and urged Murong De: “Since Zhongshan has fallen, Wei will surely exploit victory to attack Ye. Though grain has long been stored, the city is large and hard to defend, and people’s hearts are shaken; we cannot fight.
units.literal: Murong De’s nephew Murong Lin fled from Yitai to Ye and urged Murong De: “Since Zhongshan has fallen, Wei will surely exploit victory to attack Ye. Though grain has long been stored, the city is large and hard to defend, and people’s hearts are shaken; we cannot fight.

units.zh: 及魏軍未至，擁眾南渡，就魯陽王和，據滑台而聚兵積穀，伺隙而動，計之上也。
units.en: Before Wei’s army arrives, gather the host and cross south to join Prince of Luyang Murong He, occupy Huatai, mass troops, pile grain, and watch for an opening to move. This is the best plan.
units.literal: Before Wei’s army arrives, gather the host and cross south to join Prince of Luyang Murong He, occupy Huatai, mass troops, pile grain, and watch for an opening to move. This is the best plan.

units.zh: 魏雖拔中山，勢不久留，不過驅掠而返。
units.en: Even if Wei takes Zhongshan, its momentum will not remain long; it will do no more than drive off and plunder the people and then return.
units.literal: Even if Wei takes Zhongshan, its momentum will not remain long; it will do no more than drive off and plunder the people and then return.

units.zh: 人不樂徙，理自生變，然後振威以援之，魏則內外受敵，使戀舊之士有所依憑，廣開恩信，招集遺黎，可一舉而取之。」
units.en: People will not be happy to be moved, and by principle change will arise of itself. Afterward, shake your might to aid them, so that Wei suffers enemies within and without; let men who cling to their old homes have something to rely on, broadly open grace and trust, summon the scattered commoners, and you can take them in one stroke.”
units.literal: People will not be happy to be moved, and by principle change will arise of itself. Afterward, shake your might to aid them, so that Wei suffers enemies within and without; let men who cling to their old homes have something to rely on, broadly open grace and trust, summon the scattered commoners, and you can take them in one stroke.”

units.zh: 先是，慕容和亦勸德南徙，於是許之。
units.en: Murong He had already advocated a southern shift, so Murong De agreed.
units.literal: Earlier Murong He had also urged Murong De to move south, and Murong De therefore assented.

units.zh: 隆安二年，乃率戶四萬、車二萬七千乘，自鄴將徙於滑台。
units.en: In the second year of Longan Murong De moved forty thousand households and twenty-seven thousand carts from Ye toward Huatai.
units.literal: In the second year of Longan Murong De then led forty thousand households and twenty-seven thousand carts and from Ye was about to relocate to Huatai.

units.zh: 遇風，船沒，魏軍垂至，眾懼，議欲退保黎陽。
units.en: Storms sank the flotilla as Wei closed in, spreading panic and talk of retreating to Liyang.
units.literal: Murong De met wind, the boats sank, Wei's army was almost upon them, the host was afraid, and they deliberated wishing to fall back and defend Liyang.

units.zh: 其夕流澌凍合，是夜濟師，旦，魏師至而冰泮，若有神焉。
units.en: That night the river froze solid, allowing a night crossing; by morning Wei arrived as the ice thawed, as though the gods favored Murong De.
units.literal: That evening floating ice froze solid, and that night Murong De's force crossed; at dawn Wei's army arrived as the ice broke up, as if there were spirits.

units.zh: 遂改黎陽津為天橋津。
units.en: He renamed the Liyang crossing the Heavenly Bridge Ford.
units.literal: Murong De therefore changed the name of the Liyang ford to Tianqiao Ford.

units.zh: 及至滑台，景星見於尾箕。
units.en: Upon reaching Huatai, a propitious star appeared in the Tail and Basket lunar mansions.
units.literal: When Murong De reached Huatai, an auspicious star appeared in the Tail and Winnow-basket asterisms.

units.zh: 漳水得白玉，狀若璽。
units.en: The Zhang River produced white jade in the form of an imperial seal.
units.literal: The Zhang River yielded white jade shaped like a seal.

units.zh: 於是德依燕元故事，稱元年，大赦境內殊死已下，置百官。
units.en: Murong De then followed Later Yan's precedent, proclaimed his own inaugural reign, amnestied capital crimes and below, and set up a full bureaucracy.
units.literal: Thereupon Murong De, following Yan's founding precedent, declared a first year, granted a general amnesty within his borders down from capital crimes, and established the hundred offices.

units.zh: 以慕容麟為司空、領尚書令，慕容法為中軍將軍，慕輿拔為尚書左僕射，丁通為尚書右僕射，自余封授各有差。
units.en: He named Murong Lin minister of works and chief of the secretariat, Murong Fa central-army general, Yu Ba senior vice-president of the secretariat, Ding Tong junior vice-president, and distributed other posts accordingly.
units.literal: Murong De appointed Murong Lin as minister of works and concurrent director of the secretariat, Murong Fa as general of the central army, Yu Ba as left vice-director of the secretariat, Ding Tong as right vice-director of the secretariat, and the rest received titles each according to rank.

units.zh: 初，河間有麟見，慕容麟以為已瑞。
units.en: Earlier a qilin sighting in Hejian had led Murong Lin to claim it as his personal portent.
units.literal: Earlier in Hejian a unicorn had appeared, and Murong Lin had taken it as an omen for himself.

units.zh: 及此，潛謀為亂，事覺，賜死。
units.en: When his plot surfaced he was condemned to death.
units.literal: At this point Murong Lin secretly plotted rebellion; when the matter was discovered he was ordered to die.

units.zh: 其夏，魏將賀賴盧率眾附之。
units.en: That summer Helai Lu of Wei brought his command over to Murong De's side.
units.literal: That summer Wei general Helai Lu led his masses to attach himself to Murong De.

units.zh: 至是，慕容寶自龍城南奔至黎陽，遣其中黃門令趙思召慕容鍾來迎。
units.en: Murong Bao then fled south from Longcheng to Liyang and dispatched Zhao Si, his central palace gate director, to call Murong Zhong to escort him.
units.literal: At this point Murong Bao fled south from Longcheng to Liyang and sent his central yellow-gate director Zhao Si to summon Murong Zhong to come welcome him.

units.zh: 鍾本首議勸德稱尊號，聞而惡之，執思付獄，馳使白狀。
units.en: Murong Zhong, who had first urged Murong De to take the throne, took offense, jailed Zhao Si, and sent a courier to inform Murong De.
units.literal: Murong Zhong had originally been first to urge Murong De to assume the exalted title, and when he heard this he hated it, seized Zhao Si and handed him to prison, and galloped a messenger to report the situation.

units.zh: 德謂其下曰：「卿等前以社稷大計，勸吾攝政。
units.en: Murong De told his subordinates: “Earlier, for the great plan of the altars of state, you urged me to take the regency.
units.literal: Murong De told his subordinates: “Earlier, for the great plan of the altars of state, you urged me to take the regency.

units.zh: 吾亦以嗣帝奔亡，人神曠主，故權順群議，以系眾望。
units.en: I also, because the heir emperor had fled and men and spirits lacked a lord, temporarily followed the counsel of the crowd in order to hold the hopes of the multitude.
units.literal: I also, because the heir emperor had fled and men and spirits lacked a lord, temporarily followed the counsel of the crowd in order to hold the hopes of the multitude.

units.zh: 今天方悔禍，嗣帝得還，吾將具駕奉迎，謝罪行闕，然後角巾私第，卿等以為何如？」
units.en: Now Heaven is beginning to repent of the calamity, and the heir emperor may return. I will prepare my carriage to welcome him, apologize for my crimes at the traveling palace, and afterward retire in a scholar’s headcloth to a private house. What do you think?”
units.literal: Now Heaven is beginning to repent of the calamity, and the heir emperor may return. I will prepare my carriage to welcome him, apologize for my crimes at the traveling palace, and afterward retire in a scholar’s headcloth to a private house. What do you think?”

units.zh: 其黃門侍郎張華進曰：「夫爭奪之世，非雄才不振；
units.en: His Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhang Hua stepped forward and said: “In an age of struggle, only heroic talent can rouse the realm;
units.literal: His Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhang Hua stepped forward and said: “In an age of struggle, only heroic talent can rouse the realm;

units.zh: 從橫之時，豈懦夫能濟！
units.en: in a time of maneuvering, how could a coward accomplish rescue?
units.literal: in a time of maneuvering, how could a coward accomplish rescue?

units.zh: 陛下若蹈匹婦之仁，舍天授之業，威權一去，則身首不保，何退讓之有乎！」
units.en: If Your Majesty treads the kindness of a common woman, abandons the enterprise bestowed by Heaven, and lets authority and awe depart, then body and head will not be preserved. What room is there for yielding?”
units.literal: If Your Majesty treads the kindness of a common woman, abandons the enterprise bestowed by Heaven, and lets authority and awe depart, then body and head will not be preserved. What room is there for yielding?”

units.zh: 德曰：「吾以古人逆取順守，其道未足，所以中路徘徊，悵然未決耳。」
units.en: Murong De said: “I considered how the ancients seized power against the current and guarded it in accord with right, but my way is not yet sufficient; that is why I halted midway in hesitation, despondent and undecided.”
units.literal: Murong De said: “I considered how the ancients seized power against the current and guarded it in accord with right, but my way is not yet sufficient; that is why I halted midway in hesitation, despondent and undecided.”

units.zh: 慕輿護請馳問寶虛實，德流涕而遣之。
units.en: Yu Hu volunteered to ride north and learn Murong Bao's true situation; Murong De sent him off in tears.
units.literal: Yu Hu requested to gallop and inquire into Murong Bao's truth and falsehood, and Murong De wept as he sent him.

units.zh: 乃率壯士數百，隨思而北，因謀殺寶。
units.en: He led hundreds of picked men north with Zhao Si plotting to murder Murong Bao.
units.literal: Yu Hu then led several hundred stalwarts and followed Zhao Si northward and plotted to kill Murong Bao.

units.zh: 初，寶遣思之後，知德攝位，懼而北奔。
units.en: After dispatching Zhao Si, Murong Bao had learned of Murong De's assumption of power and fled north in fear.
units.literal: Earlier, after Murong Bao had sent Zhao Si, he learned that Murong De had taken the position and was afraid and fled north.

units.zh: 護至無所見，執思而還。
units.en: Yu Hu found no sign of Murong Bao, seized Zhao Si, and came back.
units.literal: When Yu Hu arrived he saw nothing, seized Zhao Si, and returned.

units.zh: 德以思閑習典故，將任之。
units.en: Murong De intended to employ Zhao Si for his knowledge of court precedent.
units.literal: Murong De, because Zhao Si was versed in precedents and stories, was about to employ him.

units.zh: 思曰：「昔關羽見重曹公，猶不忘先主之恩。
units.en: Zhao Si said: “Formerly Guan Yu was esteemed by Cao Cao, yet still did not forget his former lord’s kindness.
units.literal: Zhao Si said: “Formerly Guan Yu was esteemed by Cao Cao, yet still did not forget his former lord’s kindness.

units.zh: 思雖刑餘賤隸，荷國寵靈，犬馬有心，而況人乎！
units.en: Though I, Si, am a mutilated and base slave, I have received the state’s favor. Dogs and horses have hearts; how much more men!
units.literal: Though I, Si, am a mutilated and base slave, I have received the state’s favor. Dogs and horses have hearts; how much more men!

units.zh: 乞還就上，以明微節。」
units.en: I beg to return to my sovereign in order to make clear my slight integrity.”
units.literal: I beg to return to my sovereign in order to make clear my slight integrity.”

units.zh: 德固留之，思怒曰：「周室衰微，晉、鄭夾輔；
units.en: Murong De firmly detained him. Si grew angry and said: “When the Zhou house declined, Jin and Zheng supported it on either side;
units.literal: Murong De firmly detained him. Si grew angry and said: “When the Zhou house declined, Jin and Zheng supported it on either side;

units.zh: 漢有七國之難，實賴梁王。
units.en: when Han suffered the trouble of the seven states, it truly relied on the Prince of Liang.
units.literal: when Han suffered the trouble of the seven states, it truly relied on the Prince of Liang.

units.zh: 殿下親則叔父，位則上臺，不能率先群後以匡王室，而幸根本之傾為趙倫之事。
units.en: Your Highness, in kinship, is the emperor’s uncle, and in rank you stand among the highest ministers, yet you cannot lead the lords in aiding the royal house, but instead rejoice in the collapse of the root and foundation and act like Zhao Lun.
units.literal: Your Highness, in kinship, is the emperor’s uncle, and in rank you stand among the highest ministers, yet you cannot lead the lords in aiding the royal house, but instead rejoice in the collapse of the root and foundation and act like Zhao Lun.

units.zh: 思雖無申胥哭秦之效，猶慕君賓不生莽世。」
units.en: Though I, Si, lack Shen Baoxu’s effect of weeping at Qin, I still admire Junbin for refusing to live in Wang Mang’s age.”
units.literal: Though I, Si, lack Shen Baoxu’s effect of weeping at Qin, I still admire Junbin for refusing to live in Wang Mang’s age.”

units.zh: 德怒，斬之。
units.en: Murong De flew into a rage and had him executed.
units.literal: De was angry and beheaded him.

units.zh: 晉南陽太守閭丘羨、甯朔將軍鄧啟方率眾二萬來伐，師次管城。
units.en: The Jin governor of Nanyang, Lüqiu Xian, and Ningshuo general Deng Qifang marched twenty thousand troops against him and encamped at Guancheng.
units.literal: Jin Nanyang governor Lüqiu Xian and Ningshuo general Deng Qifang led twenty thousand men to attack; the army halted at Guancheng.

units.zh: 德遣其中軍慕容法、撫軍慕容和等距之，王師敗績。
units.en: Murong De sent the Central Army commander Murong Fa, the Pacification General Murong He, and others to resist them, and the Jin army was routed.
units.literal: De sent Central Army Murong Fa and Pacification General Murong He and others to resist them; the royal army suffered a rout.

units.zh: 德怒法不窮追晉師，斬其撫軍司馬靳瑰。
units.en: Murong De blamed Murong Fa for breaking off the pursuit of the Jin force and executed his Pacification Army major Jin Gui.
units.literal: De was angry that Fa did not pursue the Jin army to the limit, and beheaded his Pacification Army major Jin Gui.

units.zh: 初，苻登既為姚興所滅，登弟廣率部落降於德，拜冠軍將軍，處之乞活堡。
units.en: When Fu Deng fell to Yao Xing, his brother Fu Guang led their followers to submit to Murong De, who named him Champion General and settled them at Qihuo Fort.
units.literal: Earlier, after Fu Deng had been destroyed by Yao Xing, Deng's younger brother Fu Guang led his tribes to surrender to De; he was appointed Champion General and quartered at Qihuo Fort.

units.zh: 會熒惑守東井，或言秦當復興者，廣乃自稱秦王，敗德將慕容鐘。
units.en: Mars stood over Dongjing; some claimed Former Qin would revive. Fu Guang thereupon proclaimed himself King of Qin and routed Murong De's general Murong Zhong.
units.literal: When Mars occupied the Dongjing asterism, some said Qin would rise again; Guang then declared himself King of Qin and defeated De's general Murong Zhong.

units.zh: 時德始都滑台，介於晉、魏之間，地無十城，眾不過數萬。
units.en: Murong De had only just set his capital at Huatai between Jin and Wei, holding fewer than ten towns and only a few tens of thousands of troops.
units.literal: At that time De had just made Huatai his capital, caught between Jin and Wei, with fewer than ten cities and no more than a few tens of thousands of men.

units.zh: 及鐘喪師，反側之徒多歸於廣。
units.en: After Murong Zhong's defeat, many wavering followers went over to Fu Guang.
units.literal: When Zhong lost his army, wavering men mostly went over to Guang.

units.zh: 德乃留慕容和守滑台，親率眾討廣，斬之。
units.en: Murong De left Murong He to hold Huatai, marched in person against Fu Guang, and killed him.
units.literal: De then left Murong He to guard Huatai, personally led the host against Guang, and beheaded him.

units.zh: 初，寶之至黎陽也，和長史李辯勸和納之，和不從。
units.en: When Murong Bao came to Liyang, chief clerk Li Bian urged Murong He to admit him, but Murong He refused.
units.literal: Earlier, when Murong Bao reached Liyang, He's chief clerk Li Bian urged He to take Bao in, and He refused.

units.zh: 辯懼謀泄，乃引晉軍至管城，冀德親率師，於後作亂。
units.en: Li Bian feared exposure, drew Jin troops to Guancheng, and hoped Murong De would take the field himself so Li Bian could raise revolt behind him.
units.literal: Bian feared the plot would leak, so drew Jin troops to Guancheng, hoping De would personally lead the army and he could raise trouble in the rear.

units.zh: 會德不出，愈不自安。
units.en: Murong De did not march, and Li Bian grew still more anxious.
units.literal: But De did not go out, and Bian grew even more uneasy.

units.zh: 及德此行也，辯又勸和反，和不從。
units.en: When Murong De set out on this campaign, Li Bian again pressed Murong He to revolt, and Murong He again refused.
units.literal: On this expedition of De's, Bian again urged He to rebel, and He refused.

units.zh: 辯怒，殺和，以滑台降于魏。
units.en: Li Bian slew Murong He in rage and handed Huatai over to Wei.
units.literal: Bian in anger killed He and surrendered Huatai to Wei.

units.zh: 時將士家悉在城內，德將攻之，韓范言於德曰：「魏師已入城，據國成資，客主之勢，翻然復異，人情既危，不可以戰。
units.en: At that time officers' and soldiers' families were all inside the city; De was about to attack when Han Fan said to De, 'Wei troops have entered the city, hold the state and its resources; guest and host are reversed, hearts are shaken, and we cannot fight.
units.literal: At that time officers' and soldiers' families were all inside the city; De was about to attack when Han Fan said to De, 'Wei troops have entered the city, hold the state and its resources; guest and host are reversed, hearts are shaken, and we cannot fight.

units.zh: 宜先據一方，為關中之基，然後畜力而圖之，計之上也。」
units.en: We should first seize a region as a base for Guanzhong, then store strength and plan against them; that is the best plan.'
units.literal: We should first seize a region as a base for Guanzhong, then store strength and plan against them; that is the best plan.'

units.zh: 德乃止。
units.en: Murong De called off the assault.
units.literal: De then stopped.

units.zh: 德右衛將軍慕容雲斬李辯，率將士家累二萬餘人而出，三軍慶悅。
units.en: Right Guard general Murong Yun executed Li Bian and led out over twenty thousand dependents, to the army's delight.
units.literal: De's Right Guard general Murong Yun beheaded Li Bian, led more than twenty thousand officers' and soldiers' dependents out, and the three armies rejoiced.

units.zh: 德謀於眾曰：「苻廣雖平，而撫軍失據，進有強敵，退無所托，計將安出？」
units.en: De consulted the host, saying, 'Though Fu Guang is crushed, the Pacification headquarters has lost its footing; advancing we face strong foes, retreating we have nowhere to lean; what plan should we take?'
units.literal: De consulted the host, saying, 'Though Fu Guang is crushed, the Pacification headquarters has lost its footing; advancing we face strong foes, retreating we have nowhere to lean; what plan should we take?'

units.zh: 張華進曰：「彭城阻帶山川，楚之舊都，地險人殷，可攻而據之，以為基本。」
units.en: Zhang Hua stepped forward, saying, 'Pengcheng is girded by mountains and rivers, the old Chu capital; the ground is defensible and the people abundant; we can attack and hold it as our foundation.'
units.literal: Zhang Hua stepped forward, saying, 'Pengcheng is girded by mountains and rivers, the old Chu capital; the ground is defensible and the people abundant; we can attack and hold it as our foundation.'

units.zh: 慕容鐘、慕輿護、封逞、韓𧨳等固勸攻滑台，潘聰曰：「滑台四通八達，非帝王之居。
units.en: Murong Zhong, Muyu Hu, Feng Cheng, Han Fan, and others strongly urged attacking Huatai; Pan Cong said, 'Huatai is a crossroads, not a place for an emperor to dwell.
units.literal: Murong Zhong, Muyu Hu, Feng Cheng, Han Fan, and others strongly urged attacking Huatai; Pan Cong said, 'Huatai is a crossroads, not a place for an emperor to dwell.

units.zh: 且北通大魏，西接強秦，此二國者，未可以高枕而待之。
units.en: Moreover it opens north to Great Wei and west joins strong Qin; these two states are not to be awaited lying easy on a pillow.
units.literal: Moreover it opens north to Great Wei and west joins strong Qin; these two states are not to be awaited lying easy on a pillow.

units.zh: 彭城土曠人稀，地平無險，晉之歸鎮，必距王師。
units.en: Pengcheng has broad fields and thin population, flat ground without natural barriers; Jin's returning garrison is sure to block our royal army.
units.literal: Pengcheng has broad fields and thin population, flat ground without natural barriers; Jin's returning garrison is sure to block our royal army.

units.zh: 又密邇江、淮，水路通浚，秋夏霖潦，千里為湖。
units.en: It also hugs the Yangzi and Huai; waterways reach Jun, and in autumn and summer rains turn a thousand li into lakes.
units.literal: It also hugs the Yangzi and Huai; waterways reach Jun, and in autumn and summer rains turn a thousand li into lakes.

units.zh: 且水戰國之所短，吳之所長，今雖克之，非久安之計也。
units.en: Moreover water war is our state's short suit and Wu's long suit; even if we take it now, it is no plan for lasting peace.
units.literal: Moreover water war is our state's short suit and Wu's long suit; even if we take it now, it is no plan for lasting peace.

units.zh: 青、齊沃壤，號曰東秦，土方二千，戶餘十萬，四塞之固，負海之饒，可謂用武之國。
units.en: Qing and Qi are fertile soil called Eastern Qin, two thousand li square, more than a hundred thousand households, boxed by four passes, rich with the sea; it may be called a land for wielding arms.
units.literal: Qing and Qi are fertile soil called Eastern Qin, two thousand li square, more than a hundred thousand households, boxed by four passes, rich with the sea; it may be called a land for wielding arms.

units.zh: 三齊英傑，蓄志以待，孰不思得明主以立尺寸之功！
units.en: The heroes of the three Qi have stored their will and wait; who does not long for a wise lord to win even slight merit!
units.literal: The heroes of the three Qi have stored their will and wait; who does not long for a wise lord to win even slight merit!

units.zh: 廣固者，曹嶷之所營，山川阻峻，足為帝王之都。
units.en: Guanggu was built by Cao Yi; its mountains and streams are steep enough for an emperor's capital.
units.literal: Guanggu was built by Cao Yi; its mountains and streams are steep enough for an emperor's capital.

units.zh: 宜遣辯士馳說于前，大兵繼進於後，避閭渾昔負國恩，必翻然向化。
units.en: We should send eloquent men ahead to persuade them, then follow with a great army; Pilü Hun, who once betrayed the state's grace, is sure to turn toward civilization.
units.literal: We should send eloquent men ahead to persuade them, then follow with a great army; Pilü Hun, who once betrayed the state's grace, is sure to turn toward civilization.

units.zh: 如其守迷不順，大軍臨之，自然瓦解。
units.en: If he clings to delusion and will not submit, when the great host reaches him he will naturally crumble.
units.literal: If he clings to delusion and will not submit, when the great host reaches him he will naturally crumble.

units.zh: 既據之後，閉關養銳，伺隙而動，此亦二漢之有關中、河內也。」
units.en: Once we hold it, close the passes and nurse our edge, move when a gap opens; this too is like the two Han holding Guanzhong and Henei.'
units.literal: Once we hold it, close the passes and nurse our edge, move when a gap opens; this too is like the two Han holding Guanzhong and Henei.'

units.zh: 德猶豫未決。
units.en: Murong De remained undecided.
units.literal: De still hesitated and could not decide.

units.zh: 沙門郎公素知占候，德因訪其所適。
units.en: Murong De consulted the monk Lang Gong, versed in astrology.
units.literal: The monk Lang Gong was skilled in divination; De therefore asked him where they should go.

units.zh: 郎曰：「敬覽三策，潘尚書之議可謂興邦之術矣。
units.en: Lang said, 'I have reviewed the three plans; Minister Pan's counsel may be called a method to raise the state.
units.literal: Lang said, 'I have reviewed the three plans; Minister Pan's counsel may be called a method to raise the state.

units.zh: 今歲初，長星起于奎婁，遂掃虛危，而虛危，齊之分野，除舊佈新之象。
units.en: At the year's start a long comet rose in Kui and Lou, then swept Xu and Wei; Xu and Wei are Qi's field division, an omen of removing the old and spreading the new.
units.literal: At the year's start a long comet rose in Kui and Lou, then swept Xu and Wei; Xu and Wei are Qi's field division, an omen of removing the old and spreading the new.

units.zh: 宜先定舊魯，巡撫琅邪，待秋風戒節，然後北圍臨齊，天之道也。」
units.en: We should first secure old Lu, pacify Langye on tour, wait until the autumn wind sets the season, then invest Linqi from the north; that is Heaven's way.'
units.literal: We should first secure old Lu, pacify Langye on tour, wait until the autumn wind sets the season, then invest Linqi from the north; that is Heaven's way.'

units.zh: 德大悅，引師而南，兗州北鄙諸縣悉降，置守宰以撫之。
units.en: Murong De marched south, winning the north of Yanzhou and installing officials.
units.literal: De was greatly pleased, led the army south, and all counties on the northern border of Yanzhou submitted; he set governors to soothe them.

units.zh: 存問高年，軍無私掠，百姓安之，牛酒屬路。
units.en: His troops refrained from looting, elders were cared for, and locals brought food and drink to the road.
units.literal: He inquired after the aged, the army took no private plunder, the common people were at peace, and oxen and wine lined the roads.

units.zh: 德遣使喻齊郡太守避閭渾，渾不從，遣慕容鐘率步騎二萬擊之。
units.en: Murong De summoned Bi Lü Hun in Qi commandery; when he refused, Murong Zhong attacked with twenty thousand men.
units.literal: De sent envoys to instruct Qi commandery governor Bi Lü Hun; Hun refused, so De sent Murong Zhong with twenty thousand foot and horse to strike him.

units.zh: 德進據琅邪，徐、兗之土附者十餘萬，自琅邪而北，迎者四萬餘人。
units.en: Taking Langye, Murong De drew over a hundred thousand from Xu and Yanzhou and forty thousand more north of Langye.
units.literal: De advanced and occupied Langye; more than a hundred thousand men of Xu and Yanzhou attached, and north from Langye over forty thousand came to welcome him.

units.zh: 德進寇莒城，守將任安委城而遁，以潘聰鎮莒城。
units.en: He took Ju as garrison commander Ren An fled, leaving Pan Cong to hold the city.
units.literal: De advanced against Ju city; defending general Ren An abandoned the city and fled, and De set Pan Cong to hold Ju.

units.zh: 鐘傳檄青州諸郡曰：「隆替有時，義列昔經；
units.en: Zhong circulated a call to Qingzhou's commanderies, saying, 'Rise and fall have their seasons, righteousness is arrayed in the classics of old.
units.literal: Zhong circulated a call to Qingzhou's commanderies, saying, 'Rise and fall have their seasons, righteousness is arrayed in the classics of old.

units.zh: 困難啟聖，事彰中籙。
units.en: Hardship opens the way for a sage; the matter shines in the middle talisman.
units.literal: Hardship opens the way for a sage; the matter shines in the middle talisman.

units.zh: 是以宣王龍飛于危周，光武鳳起於絕漢，斯蓋歷數大期，帝王之興廢也。
units.en: Therefore King Xuan of Zhou soared from perilous Zhou, Guangwu of Han rose from dying Han; these are the great cycles by which emperors rise and fall.
units.literal: Therefore King Xuan of Zhou soared from perilous Zhou, Guangwu of Han rose from dying Han; these are the great cycles by which emperors rise and fall.

units.zh: 自我永康多難，長鯨逸網，華夏四分，黎元五裂。
units.en: From our Yongkang troubles onward, the great whale slipped the net, Huaxia split four ways, and the people were torn five ways.
units.literal: From our Yongkang troubles onward, the great whale slipped the net, Huaxia split four ways, and the people were torn five ways.

units.zh: 逆賊辟閭渾父蔚，昔同段龕阻亂淄川，太宰東征，剿絕凶命。
units.en: The rebel Bi Lü Hun's father Wei once joined Duan Kan blocking chaos on the Zi River; the grand preceptor marched east and extirpated the wicked life.
units.literal: The rebel Bi Lü Hun's father Wei once joined Duan Kan blocking chaos on the Zi River; the grand preceptor marched east and extirpated the wicked life.

units.zh: 渾于覆巢之下，蒙全卵之施，曾微犬馬識養之心，復襲凶父樂禍之志，盜據東秦，遠附吳、越，割剝黎元，委輸南海。
units.en: Under an overturned nest Hun received the favor of a spared egg, yet showed not the heart of a dog or horse toward nurture, again taking his wicked father's joy in disaster, stealing Eastern Qin, attaching far to Wu and Yue, flaying the people and shipping tribute to the southern sea.
units.literal: Under an overturned nest Hun received the favor of a spared egg, yet showed not the heart of a dog or horse toward nurture, again taking his wicked father's joy in disaster, stealing Eastern Qin, attaching far to Wu and Yue, flaying the people and shipping tribute to the southern sea.

units.zh: 皇上應期，大命再集，矜彼營丘，暫阻王略，故以七州之眾二十餘萬，巡省貸宗，問罪齊、魯。
units.en: Our sovereign answers the season; the great mandate gathers again; pitying Yingqiu he briefly blocks the royal plan, hence with the hosts of seven provinces over two hundred thousand he tours to aid the clan and calls Qi and Lu to account.
units.literal: Our sovereign answers the season; the great mandate gathers again; pitying Yingqiu he briefly blocks the royal plan, hence with the hosts of seven provinces over two hundred thousand he tours to aid the clan and calls Qi and Lu to account.

units.zh: 昔韓信以裨將伐齊，有征無戰；
units.en: Formerly Han Xin as a subordinate general attacked Qi with a campaign and no battle.
units.literal: Formerly Han Xin as a subordinate general attacked Qi with a campaign and no battle.

units.zh: 耿弇以偏軍討步，克不移朔。
units.en: Geng Yan with a detached force attacked Bu and conquered without shifting the month.
units.literal: Geng Yan with a detached force attacked Bu and conquered without shifting the month.

units.zh: 況以萬乘之師，掃一隅之寇，傾山碎卵，方之非易。
units.en: How much more with hosts of ten thousand chariots sweeping a corner bandit, toppling mountains and smashing eggs; compared to that it is not hard.
units.literal: How much more with hosts of ten thousand chariots sweeping a corner bandit, toppling mountains and smashing eggs; compared to that it is not hard.

units.zh: 孤以不才，忝荷先驅，都督元戎一十二萬，皆烏丸突騎，三河猛士，奮劍與夕火爭光，揮戈與秋月競色。
units.en: I, lacking talent, shamefully bear the vanguard, commanding one hundred twenty thousand of the main army, all Wuhuan shock cavalry and fierce men of the three He, swords vying with evening fires, spears rivaling autumn moons.
units.literal: I, lacking talent, shamefully bear the vanguard, commanding one hundred twenty thousand of the main army, all Wuhuan shock cavalry and fierce men of the three He, swords vying with evening fires, spears rivaling autumn moons.

units.zh: 以此攻城，何城不克；
units.en: With this to storm a city, what city would not fall?
units.literal: With this to storm a city, what city would not fall?

units.zh: 以此眾戰，何敵不平！
units.en: With this host to fight, what foe would not be pacified!
units.literal: With this host to fight, what foe would not be pacified!

units.zh: 昔竇融以河西歸漢，榮被于後裔；
units.en: Formerly Dou Rong brought Hexi to Han and glory spread to his descendants.
units.literal: Formerly Dou Rong brought Hexi to Han and glory spread to his descendants.

units.zh: 彭寵盜逆漁陽，身死于奴僕。
units.en: Peng Chong rebelled at Yuyang and died at the hands of slaves.
units.literal: Peng Chong rebelled at Yuyang and died at the hands of slaves.

units.zh: 近則曹嶷跋扈，見擒于後趙；
units.en: Recently Cao Yi ran riot and was captured by Later Zhao.
units.literal: Recently Cao Yi ran riot and was captured by Later Zhao.

units.zh: 段龕幹紀，取滅於前朝。
units.en: Duan Kan violated the norm and was extinguished by the prior court.
units.literal: Duan Kan violated the norm and was extinguished by the prior court.

units.zh: 此非古今之吉凶，已然之成敗乎？
units.en: Are these not the good and ill of ancient and modern, the success and failure already settled?
units.literal: Are these not the good and ill of ancient and modern, the success and failure already settled?

units.zh: 渾若先迷後悟，榮寵有加。
units.en: If Hun first errs then awakens, honor and favor will increase.
units.literal: If Hun first errs then awakens, honor and favor will increase.

units.zh: 如其敢抗王師，敗滅必無遺燼。
units.en: If he dares resist the royal army, defeat and extinction will leave not even embers.
units.literal: If he dares resist the royal army, defeat and extinction will leave not even embers.

units.zh: 稷下之雄，岱北之士，有能斬送渾者，賞同佐命。
units.en: Heroes of Jixia and knights north of Dai who can behead Hun and deliver him shall share the reward of founding ministers.
units.literal: Heroes of Jixia and knights north of Dai who can behead Hun and deliver him shall share the reward of founding ministers.

units.zh: 脫履機不發，必玉石俱摧。」
units.en: If the moment is missed, jade and stone alike will be shattered.'
units.literal: If the moment is missed, jade and stone alike will be shattered.'

units.zh: 渾聞德軍將至，從八千餘家入廣固。
units.en: Learning of Murong De's approach, Bi Lü Hun moved over eight thousand households into Guanggu.
units.literal: Hearing De's army was coming, Hun led more than eight thousand households into Guanggu.

units.zh: 諸郡皆承檄降於德。
units.en: The commanderies submitted to Murong De on Murong Zhong's summons.
units.literal: All commanderies accepted the summons and surrendered to De.

units.zh: 渾懼，將妻子奔于魏。
units.en: Bi Lü Hun fled toward Wei with his family.
units.literal: Hun was afraid and, taking wife and children, fled toward Wei.

units.zh: 德遣射聲校尉劉綱追斬於莒城。
units.en: Murong De sent She Sheng colonel Liu Gang to run him down and execute him at Ju.
units.literal: De sent She Sheng colonel Liu Gang to pursue and behead him at Ju city.

units.zh: 渾參軍張瑛常與渾作檄，辭多不遜。
units.en: Bi Lü Hun's staff officer Zhang Ying had co-written strident edicts with him.
units.literal: Hun's aide Zhang Ying had often drafted proclamations with Hun, and the language was mostly insolent.

units.zh: 及此，德擒而讓之。
units.en: Murong De captured Zhang Ying and reproached him.
units.literal: At this point De seized him and rebuked him.

units.zh: 瑛神色自若，徐對曰：「渾之有臣，猶韓信之有蒯通。
units.en: Ying was calm in mien and slowly replied, 'Hun having a subject is like Han Xin having Kuai Tong.
units.literal: Ying was calm in mien and slowly replied, 'Hun having a subject is like Han Xin having Kuai Tong.

units.zh: 通遇漢祖而蒙恕，臣遭陛下而嬰戮，比之古人，竊為不幸。
units.en: Kuai met the Han founder and was spared; your subject meets Your Majesty and suffers execution; compared to the ancients, I privately count it misfortune.
units.literal: Kuai met the Han founder and was spared; your subject meets Your Majesty and suffers execution; compared to the ancients, I privately count it misfortune.

units.zh: 防風之誅，臣實甘之，但恐堯、舜之化未弘于四海耳。」
units.en: The execution of Fangfeng I would truly accept; I only fear Yao and Shun's transforming influence has not spread across the four seas.'
units.literal: The execution of Fangfeng I would truly accept; I only fear Yao and Shun's transforming influence has not spread across the four seas.'

units.zh: 德初善其言，後竟殺之。
units.en: Murong De first admired the answer but still executed Zhang Ying.
units.literal: De at first praised his words but in the end still killed him.

units.zh: 德遂入廣固。
units.en: Murong De marched into Guanggu.
units.literal: De then entered Guanggu.

units.zh: 四年，僭即皇帝位於南郊，大赦，改元為建平，設行廟于宮南，遣使奉策告成焉。
units.en: In Long'an 4 (AD 400), he claimed the imperial title at the southern suburban altar, issued a general amnesty, inaugurated the Jianping era, established a traveling ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys bearing the accession proclamation.
units.literal: In the fourth year he usurped the emperor's title at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, set a traveling temple south of the palace, and sent envoys with the document to report completion.

units.zh: 進慕容鐘為司徒，慕輿拔為司空，封孚為左僕射，慕輿護為右僕射。
units.en: He promoted Murong Zhong to steward, Muyu Ba to minister of works, Feng Fu and Muyu Hu as left and right directors.
units.literal: He advanced Murong Zhong to Minister of Education, Muyu Ba to Minister of Works, Feng Fu to Left Director, and Muyu Hu to Right Director of the Department of State.

units.zh: 遣其度支尚書封愷、中書侍郎封逞觀省風俗，所在大饗將士。
units.en: He sent Feng Kai and Feng Cheng to tour local customs and feast the troops.
units.literal: He sent his revenue minister Feng Kai and palace aide Feng Cheng to inspect customs, feasting officers everywhere they went.

units.zh: 以其妻段氏為皇后。
units.en: He named his consort Lady Duan empress.
units.literal: He made his wife Lady Duan empress.

units.zh: 建立學官，簡公卿已下子弟及二品士門二百人為太學生。
units.en: He founded an academy with two hundred students from elite families.
units.literal: He established schools, selecting two hundred sons of dukes and ministers down to second rank gentry households as academy students.

units.zh: 後因宴其群臣，酒酣，笑而言曰：「朕雖寡薄，恭己南面而朝諸侯，在上不驕，夕惕於位，可方自古何等主也？」
units.en: Later at a banquet for his ministers, when the wine was warm he laughed and said, 'Though I am meager, I reverently face south to court the lords; not proud on high, anxious at my post by night; with whom among the ancients may I be compared?'
units.literal: Later at a banquet for his ministers, when the wine was warm he laughed and said, 'Though I am meager, I reverently face south to court the lords; not proud on high, anxious at my post by night; with whom among the ancients may I be compared?'

units.zh: 其青州刺史鞠仲曰：「陛下中興之聖後，少康、光武之儔也。」
units.en: His Qingzhou governor Ju Zhong said, 'Your Majesty is a sagely restorer of the middle revival, the peer of Shaokang and Guangwu.'
units.literal: His Qingzhou governor Ju Zhong said, 'Your Majesty is a sagely restorer of the middle revival, the peer of Shaokang and Guangwu.'

units.zh: 德顧命左右賜仲帛千匹。
units.en: Murong De told his staff to award Ju Zhong a thousand bolts of silk.
units.literal: De ordered attendants to grant Zhong a thousand bolts of silk.

units.zh: 仲以賜多為讓，德曰：「卿知調朕，朕不知調卿乎！
units.en: Zhong demurred because the gift was large; De said, 'You know how to tease me; do I not know how to tease you?
units.literal: Zhong demurred because the gift was large; De said, 'You know how to tease me; do I not know how to tease you?

units.zh: 卿飾對非實，故亦以虛言相賞，賞不謬加，何足謝也！」
units.en: You adorned your answer with what was not true, so I also reward you with empty words; the reward is not wrongly piled; what is there to thank for?'
units.literal: You adorned your answer with what was not true, so I also reward you with empty words; the reward is not wrongly piled; what is there to thank for?'

units.zh: 韓範進曰：「臣聞天子無戲言，忠臣無妄對。
units.en: Han Fan stepped forward, saying, 'I have heard the Son of Heaven has no jesting words and loyal ministers have no reckless answers.
units.literal: Han Fan stepped forward, saying, 'I have heard the Son of Heaven has no jesting words and loyal ministers have no reckless answers.

units.zh: 今日之論，上下相欺，可謂君臣俱失。」
units.en: Today's discussion has ruler and subject deceiving each other; it may be called both sides failing.'
units.literal: Today's discussion has ruler and subject deceiving each other; it may be called both sides failing.'

units.zh: 德大悅，賜範絹五十匹。
units.en: Murong De delighted in the rebuke and gave Han Fan fifty bolts of silk.
units.literal: De was greatly pleased and granted Fan fifty bolts of silk.

units.zh: 自是昌言競進，朝多直士矣。
units.en: Frank counsel flourished and the court gained upright officials.
units.literal: From then forth straight speech vied to advance and the court had many honest men.

units.zh: 德母兄先在長安，遣平原人杜弘如長安問存否，弘曰：「臣至長安，若不奉太后動止，便即西如張掖，以死為效。
units.en: De's mother and elder brother were first in Chang'an; he sent Pingyuan man Du Hong to Chang'an to ask whether they still lived, and Hong said, 'If I reach Chang'an and do not bring back news of the empress dowager's condition, I will go west to Zhangye and die to prove my loyalty.
units.literal: De's mother and elder brother were first in Chang'an; he sent Pingyuan man Du Hong to Chang'an to ask whether they still lived, and Hong said, 'If I reach Chang'an and do not bring back news of the empress dowager's condition, I will go west to Zhangye and die to prove my loyalty.

units.zh: 臣父雄年逾六十，未沾榮貴，乞本縣之祿，以申烏鳥之情。」
units.en: My father Xiong is past sixty and has not tasted honor; I beg the salary of our home county to express the crow's filial heart.'
units.literal: My father Xiong is past sixty and has not tasted honor; I beg the salary of our home county to express the crow's filial heart.'

units.zh: 張華進曰：「杜弘未行而求祿，要利情深，不可使也。」
units.en: Zhang Hua stepped forward, saying, 'Du Hong has not yet gone but seeks salary; his desire for profit runs deep; he cannot be used.'
units.literal: Zhang Hua stepped forward, saying, 'Du Hong has not yet gone but seeks salary; his desire for profit runs deep; he cannot be used.'

units.zh: 德曰：「吾方散所輕之財，招所重之死，況為親尊而可吝乎！
units.en: De said, 'I am now scattering the wealth I lightly esteem to recruit the deaths I heavily value; how could I be stingy for a revered kinsman?
units.literal: De said, 'I am now scattering the wealth I lightly esteem to recruit the deaths I heavily value; how could I be stingy for a revered kinsman?

units.zh: 且弘為君迎親，為父求祿，雖外如要利，內實忠孝。」
units.en: Moreover Hong goes for the ruler to welcome kin and for his father seeks salary; though outwardly like seeking profit, inwardly it is loyalty and filial piety.'
units.literal: Moreover Hong goes for the ruler to welcome kin and for his father seeks salary; though outwardly like seeking profit, inwardly it is loyalty and filial piety.'

units.zh: 乃以雄為平原令。
units.en: Murong De named Du Xiong magistrate of Pingyuan.
units.literal: He therefore appointed Xiong governor of Pingyuan.

units.zh: 弘至張掖，為盜所殺，德聞而悲之，厚撫其妻子。
units.en: Du Hong was killed by bandits at Zhangye; Murong De mourned him and richly aided his family.
units.literal: Hong reached Zhangye and was killed by bandits; De heard and grieved, treating his wife and children generously.

units.zh: 明年，德如齊城，登營丘，望晏嬰塚，顧謂左右曰：「禮，大夫不逼城葬。
units.en: The next year De went to Qi city, climbed Yingqiu, gazed on Yan Ying's mound, and said to those around him, 'By ritual a great officer is not buried pressing the city wall.
units.literal: The next year De went to Qi city, climbed Yingqiu, gazed on Yan Ying's mound, and said to those around him, 'By ritual a great officer is not buried pressing the city wall.

units.zh: 平仲古之賢人，達禮者也，而生居近市，死葬近城，豈有意乎？」
units.en: Pingzhong was a worthy of old, one who understood ritual, yet lived near the market in life and is buried near the city in death; did he intend it?'
units.literal: Pingzhong was a worthy of old, one who understood ritual, yet lived near the market in life and is buried near the city in death; did he intend it?'

units.zh: 青州秀才晏謨對曰：「孔子稱臣先人平仲賢，則賢矣。
units.en: Qingzhou xiucai Yan Mo replied, 'Confucius called my ancestor Pingzhong worthy; worthy he was.
units.literal: Qingzhou xiucai Yan Mo replied, 'Confucius called my ancestor Pingzhong worthy; worthy he was.

units.zh: 豈不知高其梁，豐其禮？
units.en: Could he not have known to raise his ridgepole and enrich his rites?
units.literal: Could he not have known to raise his ridgepole and enrich his rites?

units.zh: 蓋政在家門，故儉以矯世。
units.en: In sum government was in the family gate, therefore he used frugality to correct the age.
units.literal: In sum government was in the family gate, therefore he used frugality to correct the age.

units.zh: 存居湫隘，卒豈擇地而葬乎！
units.en: He lived in a cramped low place; at death could he choose ground to bury!
units.literal: He lived in a cramped low place; at death could he choose ground to bury!

units.zh: 所以不遠門者，猶冀悟平生意也。」
units.en: The reason he did not distance the gate was still hoping to awaken Pingzhong's intent in life.'
units.literal: The reason he did not distance the gate was still hoping to awaken Pingzhong's intent in life.'

units.zh: 遂以謨從至漢城陽景王廟，宴庶老于申池，北登社首山，東望鼎足，因目牛山而歎曰：「古無不死！」
units.en: Thereupon he took Yan Mo along to the temple of Prince Jing of Chengyang at Hancheng, feasted the common elders at Shen Pool, climbed north Mount Sheshou, looked east at the tripod legs of terrain, then gazed at Mount Niu and sighed, saying, 'From antiquity there has been no not dying!'
units.literal: Thereupon he took Yan Mo along to the temple of Prince Jing of Chengyang at Hancheng, feasted the common elders at Shen Pool, climbed north Mount Sheshou, looked east at the tripod legs of terrain, then gazed at Mount Niu and sighed, saying, 'From antiquity there has been no not dying!'

units.zh: 愴然有終焉之志。
units.en: He was overcome with melancholy and half wished to end his days there.
units.literal: He was mournful and had the will to end there.

units.zh: 遂問謨以齊之山川丘陵，賢哲舊事。
units.en: He quizzed Yan Mo on Qi's geography and famous stories.
units.literal: Thereupon he asked Yan Mo about Qi mountains and rivers, mounds and hills, worthies and ancient affairs.

units.zh: 謨曆對詳辯，畫地成圖。
units.en: Yan Mo answered in fluent detail and sketched a map in the dust.
units.literal: Yan Mo answered in sequence, detailed and disputatious, and drew lines on the ground to make a map.

units.zh: 德深嘉之，拜尚書郎。
units.en: Murong De was so impressed he named him a gentleman of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: De deeply praised him and appointed him gentleman of the masters of writing.

units.zh: 立冶于商山，置鹽官于烏常澤，以廣軍國之用。
units.en: He opened ironworks on Mount Shang and salt monopolies at Wuchang Marsh to swell the army's coffers.
units.literal: He set up smelting works on Mount Shang and salt offices at Wuchang Marsh to broaden military and state use.

units.zh: 德故吏趙融自長安來，始具母兄凶問，德號慟吐血，因而寢疾。
units.en: His old clerk Zhao Rong arrived from Chang'an with word of his mother and brother's deaths; Murong De howled until he coughed blood and fell gravely ill.
units.literal: De's former clerk Zhao Rong came from Chang'an and first brought full news of the mourning for mother and elder brother; De wailed and spat blood, and on that account took to bed ill.

units.zh: 其司隸校尉慕容達因此謀反，遣牙門皇璆率眾攻端門，殿中師侯赤眉開門應之。
units.en: Metropolitan commandant Murong Da seized the moment to rebel, sent Huang Kui against the Duan Gate, and won inside help from Hou Chimei.
units.literal: His metropolitan commandant Murong Da thereupon plotted rebellion, sent gate guard Huang Kui to lead a host attacking the Duan Gate, and palace instructor Hou Chimei opened the gate in response.

units.zh: 中黃門遜進扶德逾城，隱於進舍。
units.en: A eunuch helped Murong De over the wall into hiding.
units.literal: Palace attendant Xun Jin helped De over the wall and hid him in a forward lodging.

units.zh: 段宏等聞宮中有變，勒兵屯四門。
units.en: Duan Hong and the rest heard the alarm and sealed the four gates with troops.
units.literal: Duan Hong and others heard there was turmoil in the palace and led troops to camp at the four gates.

units.zh: 德入宮，誅赤眉等，達懼而奔魏。
units.en: Murong De re-entered the palace, executed Hou Chimei's faction, and Murong Da fled to Wei.
units.literal: De entered the palace, executed Chimei and the rest, and Da fled in fear to Wei.

units.zh: 慕容法及魏師戰於濟北之摽榆俗，魏師敗績。
units.en: Murong Fa clashed with Wei north of Ji near Biaoyu and routed them.
units.literal: Murong Fa together with Wei troops fought north of Ji at Biaoyu ford; Wei troops suffered a rout.

units.zh: 其尚書韓𧨳上疏曰：「二寇逋誅，國恥未雪，關西為豺鋃之藪，楊越為鴟鴞之林，三京社稷，鞠為丘墟，四祖園陵，蕪而不守，豈非義夫憤歎之日，烈士忘身之秋。
units.en: His minister Han Fan submitted a memorial saying, 'The two bandits roam unpunished, national shame is not washed away; west of the pass is a den of wolves, Yang and Yue are a forest of owls; the three capitals' altars have become mounds, the four ancestors' mausoleums lie weed-choked and undefended—is this not the day for righteous men to sigh and for knights to forget their bodies.
units.literal: His minister Han Fan submitted a memorial saying, 'The two bandits roam unpunished, national shame is not washed away; west of the pass is a den of wolves, Yang and Yue are a forest of owls; the three capitals' altars have become mounds, the four ancestors' mausoleums lie weed-choked and undefended—is this not the day for righteous men to sigh and for knights to forget their bodies.

units.zh: 而皇室多難，威略未振，是使長蛇弗翦，封豕假息。
units.en: Yet the royal house has many hardships and martial awe has not yet risen, so the long serpent is not cut and the great boar catches its breath.
units.literal: Yet the royal house has many hardships and martial awe has not yet risen, so the long serpent is not cut and the great boar catches its breath.

units.zh: 人懷憤慨，常謂一日之安不可以永久，終朝之逸無卒歲之憂。
units.en: Men harbor indignation, always saying a single day's peace cannot last forever, a morning's ease brings no year's rest.
units.literal: Men harbor indignation, always saying a single day's peace cannot last forever, a morning's ease brings no year's rest.

units.zh: 陛下中興大業，務在遵養，矜遷萌之失土，假長復而不役，湣黎庶之息肩，貴因循而不擾。
units.en: Your Majesty's restoration enterprise stresses compliance and nurturing, pitying displaced refugees' lost lands and granting long recovery without corvée, sympathizing with the people's rested shoulders and prizing continuity without harassment.
units.literal: Your Majesty's restoration enterprise stresses compliance and nurturing, pitying displaced refugees' lost lands and granting long recovery without corvée, sympathizing with the people's rested shoulders and prizing continuity without harassment.

units.zh: 斯可以保甯于營丘，難以經措于秦、越。
units.en: This can preserve peace at Yingqiu but is hard to apply to Qin and Yue.
units.literal: This can preserve peace at Yingqiu but is hard to apply to Qin and Yue.

units.zh: 今群凶僭逆，實繁有徒，據我三方，伺國瑕釁。
units.en: Now many villains usurp and rebel, truly a host of followers hold our three sides and watch for cracks in the state.
units.literal: Now many villains usurp and rebel, truly a host of followers hold our three sides and watch for cracks in the state.

units.zh: 深宜審量虛實，大校成敗，養兵厲甲，廣農積糧，進為雪恥討寇之資，退為山河萬全之固。
units.en: It is deeply fitting to weigh void and substance, broadly gauge victory and defeat, nurture troops and harden armor, widen farming and pile grain, advance as capital to wash shame and punish bandits, retreat as a ten-thousand-li bulwark of mountains and rivers.
units.literal: It is deeply fitting to weigh void and substance, broadly gauge victory and defeat, nurture troops and harden armor, widen farming and pile grain, advance as capital to wash shame and punish bandits, retreat as a ten-thousand-li bulwark of mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 而百姓因秦、晉之弊，迭相陰憲，或百室合戶，或千丁共籍，依託城社，不懼燻燒，公避課役，擅為奸宄，損風毀憲，法所不容，但檢今未宣，弗可加戮。
units.en: Yet the common people, inheriting the harm of Qin and Jin, successively conspire in shadow; some hundred households share one register, some thousand adult males share one roll, relying on altars of soil and grain and fearing no burning, publicly avoiding taxes and labor, recklessly acting treacherous, harming custom and destroying statutes—what the law cannot tolerate—but because inspection has not yet been proclaimed, we cannot yet add execution.
units.literal: Yet the common people, inheriting the harm of Qin and Jin, successively conspire in shadow; some hundred households share one register, some thousand adult males share one roll, relying on altars of soil and grain and fearing no burning, publicly avoiding taxes and labor, recklessly acting treacherous, harming custom and destroying statutes—what the law cannot tolerate—but because inspection has not yet been proclaimed, we cannot yet add execution.

units.zh: 今宜隱實黎萌，正其編貫，庶上增皇朝理物之明，下益軍國兵資之用。
units.en: Now it is fitting to reveal the truth about the common folk, correct their household rolls, so above we increase the court's clarity in ordering things, below we add to army and state use of soldiers and supplies.
units.literal: Now it is fitting to reveal the truth about the common folk, correct their household rolls, so above we increase the court's clarity in ordering things, below we add to army and state use of soldiers and supplies.

units.zh: 若蒙採納，冀裨山海，雖遇商鞅之刑，悅綰之害，所不辭也。」
units.en: If this is adopted, I hope it will add even a little to mountains and seas. Though I meet Shang Yang’s punishment or Yue Wan’s harm, I will not decline.”
units.literal: If this is adopted, I hope it will add even a little to mountains and seas. Though I meet Shang Yang’s punishment or Yue Wan’s harm, I will not decline.”

units.zh: 德納之，遣其車騎將軍慕容鎮率騎三千，緣邊嚴防，備百姓逃竄。
units.en: Murong De agreed and sent Murong Zhen to seal the frontier against flight.
units.literal: De accepted it and sent chariot-and-cavalry general Murong Zhen with three thousand horse to patrol the border strictly and guard against commoners fleeing.

units.zh: 以𧨳為使持節、散騎常侍、行台尚書，巡郡縣隱實，得廕戶五萬八千。
units.en: He named Han Fan inspector and uncovered fifty-eight thousand concealed households.
units.literal: He appointed Han Fan as commissioner bearing credentials, regular attendant for scattered cavalry, acting director of the traveling headquarters, to tour commanderies and counties and reveal truth, obtaining fifty-eight thousand hidden households.

units.zh: 𧨳公廉正直，所在野次，人不擾焉。
units.en: Han Fan camped in the fields and never troubled the locals.
units.literal: Han Fan was fair, incorrupt, and upright; wherever he went he camped in the open and people were not disturbed.

units.zh: 德大集諸生，親臨策試。
units.en: Murong De convened the academy and presided over the examinations himself.
units.literal: De greatly gathered the students and personally attended the policy examination.

units.zh: 既而饗宴，乘高遠矚，顧謂其尚書魯邃曰：「齊、魯固多君子，當昔全盛之時，接、慎、巴生、淳于、鄒、田之徒，廕修簷，臨清沼，馳硃輪，佩長劍，恣非馬之雄辭，奮談天之逸辯，指麾則紅紫成章，俯仰則丘陵生韻，至於今日，荒草頹墳，氣消煙滅，永言千載，能不依然！」
units.en: Presently he feasted, rode high and looked far, and said to his minister Lu Sui, 'Qi and Lu surely had many gentlemen; in their full splendor men like Jie, Shen, Ba Sheng, Chunyu, Zou, and Tian sheltered under broad eaves, leaned on clear pools, raced vermillion wheels, wore long swords, vented heroic rhetoric, raised heaven-storming debate, gestured and purple and red formed patterns, bowed and hills and mounds took rhythm; down to today wild grass and ruined tombs, breath gone smoke extinguished—speaking of a thousand years, how can one not be moved!'
units.literal: Presently he feasted, rode high and looked far, and said to his minister Lu Sui, 'Qi and Lu surely had many gentlemen; in their full splendor men like Jie, Shen, Ba Sheng, Chunyu, Zou, and Tian sheltered under broad eaves, leaned on clear pools, raced vermillion wheels, wore long swords, vented heroic rhetoric, raised heaven-storming debate, gestured and purple and red formed patterns, bowed and hills and mounds took rhythm; down to today wild grass and ruined tombs, breath gone smoke extinguished—speaking of a thousand years, how can one not be moved!'

units.zh: 邃答曰：「武王封比干之墓，漢祖祭信陵之墳，皆留心賢哲，每懷往事。
units.en: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou raised a mound over Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.
units.literal: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou raised a mound over Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.

units.zh: 陛下慈深二主，澤被九泉，若使彼而有知，寧不銜荷矣。」
units.en: Your Majesty's kindness runs deeper than those two lords, your grace reaches the nine springs; if they had consciousness, how would they not bear gratitude in their mouths!'
units.literal: Your Majesty's kindness runs deeper than those two lords, your grace reaches the nine springs; if they had consciousness, how would they not bear gratitude in their mouths!'

units.zh: 先是，妖賊王始聚眾於太山，自稱太平皇帝，號其父為太上皇，兄為征東將軍，弟征西將軍。
units.en: A charlatan named Wang Shi had declared himself emperor on Mount Tai with a full family of bogus titles.
units.literal: Earlier, demon bandit Wang Shi gathered a host at Mount Tai, styled himself emperor of Great Peace, titled his father retired emperor, elder brother general who campaigns east, younger brother general who campaigns west.

units.zh: 慕容鎮討擒之，斬於都市。
units.en: Murong Zhen took him and executed him publicly.
units.literal: Murong Zhen campaigned, captured him, and beheaded him in the great market.

units.zh: 臨刑，或問其父及兄弟所在，始答曰：「太上皇帝蒙塵於外，征東、征西亂兵所害。
units.en: At execution someone asked where his father and brothers were; Shi answered, 'The retired emperor wanders in dust without, the east and west generals were killed by mutinous troops.
units.literal: At execution someone asked where his father and brothers were; Shi answered, 'The retired emperor wanders in dust without, the east and west generals were killed by mutinous troops.

units.zh: 惟朕一身，獨無聊賴。」
units.en: Only I alone remain, utterly without support.'
units.literal: Only I alone remain, utterly without support.'

units.zh: 其妻怒之曰：「止坐此口，以至於此，奈何復爾！」
units.en: His wife angrily said, 'It is only because of this mouth that you reached this; how can you do it again!'
units.literal: His wife angrily said, 'It is only because of this mouth that you reached this; how can you do it again!'

units.zh: 始曰：「皇后！
units.en: Shi said, 'Empress!
units.literal: Shi said, 'Empress!

units.zh: 自古豈有不破之家，不亡之國邪！」
units.en: From antiquity has there been a house that never broke, a state that never perished!'
units.literal: From antiquity has there been a house that never broke, a state that never perished!'

units.zh: 行刑者以刀環築之，仰視曰：「崩即崩矣，終不改帝號。」
units.en: The executioner struck him with the ring of the blade; looking up he said, 'Collapse it may collapse, I will never change the imperial title.'
units.literal: The executioner struck him with the ring of the blade; looking up he said, 'Collapse it may collapse, I will never change the imperial title.'

units.zh: 德聞而哂之。
units.en: Murong De only laughed.
units.literal: De heard and sneered.

units.zh: 時桓玄將行篡逆，誅不附己者。
units.en: When Huan Xuan prepared his coup he purged dissenters.
units.literal: At that time Huan Xuan was about to carry out usurpation and killed those who would not attach to him.

units.zh: 冀州刺史劉軌、襄城太守司馬休之、征虜將軍劉敬宣、廣陵相高雅之、江都長張誕並內不自安，皆奔於德。
units.en: Liu Gui, inspector of Ji Province; Sima Xiuzhi, governor of Xiangcheng; Liu Jingxuan, General Who Conquers Caitiffs; Gao Yazhi, chancellor of Guangling; and Zhang Dan, magistrate of Jiangdu, all felt unsafe within Jin territory and fled to Murong De.
units.literal: Ji Province inspector Liu Gui, Xiangcheng prefect Sima Xiuzhi, general who captures barbarians Liu Jingxuan, Guangling chancellor Gao Yazhi, and Jiangdu magistrate Zhang Dan all felt insecure within and fled to De.

units.zh: 於是德中書侍郎韓范上疏曰：「夫帝王之道，必崇經略。
units.en: Thereupon De's palace aide Han Fan submitted a memorial saying, 'The way of emperors and kings must honor planning and strategy.
units.literal: Thereupon De's palace aide Han Fan submitted a memorial saying, 'The way of emperors and kings must honor planning and strategy.

units.zh: 有其時無其人，則弘濟之功闕；
units.en: Having the time without the man, then the work of great rescue is lacking;
units.literal: Having the time without the man, then the work of great rescue is lacking;

units.zh: 有其人無其時，則英武之志不申。
units.en: Having the man without the time, then heroic martial intent is not displayed.
units.literal: Having the man without the time, then heroic martial intent is not displayed.

units.zh: 至於能成王業者，惟人時合也。
units.en: As for those able to complete kingly work, only when man and time align.
units.literal: As for those able to complete kingly work, only when man and time align.

units.zh: 自晉國內難，七載於茲。
units.en: Since Jin's internal disaster, seven years have passed here.
units.literal: Since Jin's internal disaster, seven years have passed here.

units.zh: 桓玄逆篡，虐逾董卓，神怒人怨，其殃積矣。
units.en: Huan Xuan usurped in rebellion, his cruelty surpassing Dong Zhuo; gods angry and men resentful, his calamities are piled.
units.literal: Huan Xuan usurped in rebellion, his cruelty surpassing Dong Zhuo; gods angry and men resentful, his calamities are piled.

units.zh: 可乘之機，莫過此也。
units.en: A chance to strike exceeds none other than this.
units.literal: A chance to strike exceeds none other than this.

units.zh: 以陛下之神武，經而緯之，驅樂奮之卒，接厭亂之機，譬猶聲發回應，形動影隨，未足比其易也。
units.en: With Your Majesty's divine martial quality, ordering warp and weft, driving troops eager for joy, joining a world weary of chaos, it is like sound issuing and echo answering, form moving and shadow following—not enough to compare its ease.
