units.literal: With Your Majesty's divine martial quality, ordering warp and weft, driving troops eager for joy, joining a world weary of chaos, it is like sound issuing and echo answering, form moving and shadow following—not enough to compare its ease.

units.zh: 且江、淮南北戶口未幾，公私戎馬不過數百，守備之事蓋亦微矣。
units.en: Moreover north and south of the Yangzi and Huai households are still few; public and private war horses number only in the hundreds; matters of defense are also slight.
units.literal: Moreover north and south of the Yangzi and Huai households are still few; public and private war horses number only in the hundreds; matters of defense are also slight.

units.zh: 若以步騎一萬，建雷霆之舉，卷甲長驅，指臨江、會，必望旗草偃，壺漿屬路。
units.en: If with ten thousand foot and horse we raise a thunderstroke, roll armor in a long drive, point to Linjiang and Kuaiji, they are sure to lower banners like grass bending, and jars of broth will line the road.
units.literal: If with ten thousand foot and horse we raise a thunderstroke, roll armor in a long drive, point to Linjiang and Kuaiji, they are sure to lower banners like grass bending, and jars of broth will line the road.

units.zh: 跨地數千，眾逾十萬，可以西並強秦，北抗大魏。
units.en: Spanning several thousand li, hosts exceeding a hundred thousand, we could west merge with strong Qin and north resist Great Wei.
units.literal: Spanning several thousand li, hosts exceeding a hundred thousand, we could west merge with strong Qin and north resist Great Wei.

units.zh: 夫欲拓境開疆，保寧社稷，無過今也。
units.en: For desiring to widen territory and open frontiers, guarding altars of soil and grain, nothing surpasses now.
units.literal: For desiring to widen territory and open frontiers, guarding altars of soil and grain, nothing surpasses now.

units.zh: 如使後機失會，豪桀復起，梟除桓玄，布惟新之化，遐邇既寧，物無異望，非但建鄴難屠，江北亦不可冀。
units.en: If afterward the opportunity slips and heroes rise again, when Huan Xuan is cut off and only fresh reform spreads, far and near already calm and things without other hope, not only Jiankang will be hard to butcher, the north of the river also cannot be hoped for.
units.literal: If afterward the opportunity slips and heroes rise again, when Huan Xuan is cut off and only fresh reform spreads, far and near already calm and things without other hope, not only Jiankang will be hard to butcher, the north of the river also cannot be hoped for.

units.zh: 機過患生，憂必至矣。
units.en: When the opportunity passes, calamity arises; worry is sure to arrive.
units.literal: When the opportunity passes, calamity arises; worry is sure to arrive.

units.zh: 天與不取，悔將及焉。
units.en: Heaven gives and we do not take; regret will reach us.
units.literal: Heaven gives and we do not take; regret will reach us.

units.zh: 惟陛下覽之。」
units.en: Only may Your Majesty consider it.'
units.literal: Only may Your Majesty consider it.'

units.zh: 德曰：「自頃數纏百六，宏綱暫弛，遂令奸逆亂華，舊京墟穢，每尋否運，憤慨兼懷。
units.en: De said, 'Recently fate has repeatedly tangled in misfortune, the great net hung slack, letting treacherous rebels disorder the Hua heartland and the old capital lie in filth; each time I ponder this ill fortune, indignation fills my breast.
units.literal: De said, 'Recently fate has repeatedly tangled in misfortune, the great net hung slack, letting treacherous rebels disorder the Hua heartland and the old capital lie in filth; each time I ponder this ill fortune, indignation fills my breast.

units.zh: 昔少康以一旅之眾，復夏配天，況朕據三齊之地，藉五州之眾，教之以軍旅，訓之以禮讓，上下知義，人思自奮，繕甲待釁，為日久矣。
units.en: Formerly Shaokang with one brigade's host restored Xia and matched Heaven; how much more I occupy the land of the three Qi, rely on the hosts of five provinces, teach them with armies, train them with ritual yielding; above and below know righteousness, each man thinks to rouse himself; we repair armor and await a crack—this has been long.
units.literal: Formerly Shaokang with one brigade's host restored Xia and matched Heaven; how much more I occupy the land of the three Qi, rely on the hosts of five provinces, teach them with armies, train them with ritual yielding; above and below know righteousness, each man thinks to rouse himself; we repair armor and await a crack—this has been long.

units.zh: 但欲先定中原，掃除逋孽，然後宣佈淳風，經理九服，飲馬長江，懸旌隴阪。
units.en: But I wish first to settle the central plain, sweep away fleeing villains, then spread pure wind, order the nine domains, drink horses at the Yangzi, hang banners on the Long slopes.
units.literal: But I wish first to settle the central plain, sweep away fleeing villains, then spread pure wind, order the nine domains, drink horses at the Yangzi, hang banners on the Long slopes.

units.zh: 此志未遂，且韜戈耳。
units.en: This intent is not yet fulfilled; for now we sheathe the spears only.
units.literal: This intent is not yet fulfilled; for now we sheathe the spears only.

units.zh: 今者之事，王公其詳議之。」
units.en: As for today's matter, let the royal dukes deliberate in detail.'
units.literal: As for today's matter, let the royal dukes deliberate in detail.'

units.zh: 咸以桓玄新得志，未可圖，乃止。
units.en: The court judged Huan Xuan too strong for the moment and dropped the idea.
units.literal: All thought Huan Xuan newly triumphant and not yet to be plotted against, and therefore stopped.

units.zh: 於是講武於城西，步兵三十七萬，車一萬七千乘，鐵騎五萬三千，周亙山澤，旌旗彌漫，鉦鼓之聲，振動天地。
units.en: He staged a review west of the city with hundreds of thousands on parade.
units.literal: Thereupon he drilled troops west of the city: three hundred seventy thousand foot, seventeen thousand carts, fifty-three thousand armored horse, filling mountains and marshes, banners covering heaven, the clash of gongs and drums shaking heaven and earth.

units.zh: 德登高望之，顧謂劉軌、高雅之曰：「昔郤克仇齊，子胥怨楚，終能暢其剛烈，名流千載。
units.en: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.
units.literal: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.

units.zh: 卿等既知投身有道，當使無慚昔人也。」
units.en: You gentlemen already know to cast yourselves onto a rightful way; you should make yourselves not ashamed before the ancients.'
units.literal: You gentlemen already know to cast yourselves onto a rightful way; you should make yourselves not ashamed before the ancients.'

units.zh: 雅之等頓首答曰：「幸蒙陛下天覆之恩，大造之澤，存亡繼絕，實在聖時，雖則萬隕，何以上報！」
units.en: Yazhi and the others bowed their heads to the ground and replied: “We have fortunately received Your Majesty’s heaven-covering grace and great creative favor, preserving the dying and continuing the cut off. Truly this lies in a sage age; even if we fell ten thousand times, how could we repay it above!”
units.literal: Yazhi and the others bowed their heads to the ground and replied: “We have fortunately received Your Majesty’s heaven-covering grace and great creative favor, preserving the dying and continuing the cut off. Truly this lies in a sage age; even if we fell ten thousand times, how could we repay it above!”

units.zh: 俄聞桓玄敗，德以慕容鎮為前鋒，慕容鐘為大都督，配以步卒二萬，騎五千，克期將發，而德寢疾，於是罷兵。
units.en: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; Murong De made Murong Zhen the vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, assigning twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse with a set departure date, but Murong De fell ill and therefore halted the army.
units.literal: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; De made Murong Zhen vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, pairing them with twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse, fixing a date to set out, but De took to bed ill, and therefore the army was halted.

units.zh: 初，德迎其兄子超于長安，及是而至。
units.en: Murong Chao, whom he had summoned from Chang'an, now arrived.
units.literal: Earlier, De had welcomed his brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.

units.zh: 德夜夢其父曰：「汝既無子，何不早立超為太子，不爾，惡人生心。」
units.en: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'
units.literal: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'

units.zh: 寐而告其妻曰：「先帝神明所敕，觀此夢意，吾將死矣。」
units.en: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'
units.literal: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'

units.zh: 乃下書以超為皇太子，大赦境內，子為父後者人爵二級。
units.en: He named Murong Chao crown prince and issued a broad amnesty.
units.literal: Thereupon he issued an edict making Chao crown prince, amnestied the realm, and for sons continuing fathers raised each man's rank two grades.

units.zh: 其月死，即義熙元年也，時年七十。
units.en: He died the same month, in the first year of Yixi, at seventy sui.
units.literal: That month he died; it was the first year of Yixi, and at the time his age was seventy sui.

units.zh: 乃夜為十餘棺，分出四門，潛葬山谷，竟不知其屍之所在。
units.en: They ran decoy coffers out each gate and hid his true burial in the hills.
units.literal: That night they made more than ten coffins, sent them out the four gates separately, and secretly buried him in mountain valleys; in the end none knew where his corpse lay.

units.zh: 在位五年。
units.en: His reign lasted five years.
units.literal: He held the throne five years.

units.zh: 偽諡獻武皇帝。
units.en: His temple posthumous title was Emperor Xianwu.
units.literal: He was posthumously titled Emperor Xianwu.
